name: house-kv-project-standard
disclaimer: 本文件是仓库从范例程序归纳出的内部约定，不是 KEYENCE 的产品要求。KV STUDIO 不强制任何命名或分区，因此检查结果只能作为建议：必须先向用户展示结论并询问是否按范例调整，不得据此判定项目“错误”或擅自改工程。

layers.expects: 可复用逻辑的 FB 本体（;MODULE_TYPE:2），命名 ^FB_

layers.layer: 程序/每次扫描执行型模块
layers.expects: 工站程序 ST##_*、设备或轴控制 A#_*、平台功能（初始化/设备状态/Alarm/HMI/IO*）、调用层 调用*FB
版本管理、上电或收尾只执行一次的逻辑
与实际硬件一致，有单元就要在树里可见
用户变量用业务命名；自定义类型按 str<域> + Ctrl/Param/Status/IO 分层

naming.pattern: ^(IO输入|IO输出|高速计数器输入|模拟量输入|初始化|设备状态|Alarm|报警|HMI|版本管理|安全|配方)$

station_model.expects: 每个工站一段独立程序（不互相跳转），工站之间由主流程或上位机编排；工站相关的数据结构沿用 str<域>* 分层
station_model.note: 范例用 ST00..ST06 表示工位/工序；项目确实没有工位概念时可以不用，但要在项目总结里写明

fb_model.expects: FB 只依赖自变量与局部状态；真实设备映射、轴/单元绑定、全局实例留在调用方

reuse_principle.decision: owner decision 2026-11 (revised): official/unit-library function blocks come FIRST. If the vendor already provides the capability (axis motion control, communication connect/send/receive, alarm reset), call it directly with site signals as arguments; never rebuild its edge/latch/interlock/busy logic in ladder, and never wrap an official FB in a user FB just to give it a name. Extract a user FB only when no official FB covers the capability AND the same logic repeats in two or more places and depends only on its arguments.
reuse_principle.basis: house convention recorded by the project owner, not a KEYENCE requirement
ordering: 1. use the official/unit-library FB directly when it covers the capability
2. only when no official FB covers it, check whether the same logic repeats in two or more places
3. extract to 功能块/FB_* and call it from every site program
4. conditions whose meaning is unknown stay as inputs and are reported, never bypassed

candidate_classes.name: official_fb_available_but_reimplemented_in_ladder
candidate_classes.evidence_requirement: KEYENCE manual/wiki card for the official FB (its Execute/Busy/Done/Error semantics) plus the hand-written ladder that duplicates them; without the card the finding is only a candidate
detection: hand-built edge + self-hold + done-reset wrapped around an MC_* / communication FB call
the FB instance is called with ??? for Execute/Busy/Done/Error and the program invents its own status bits with SET/RES/SHOT
direction mutual exclusion or busy flags written by hand while the FB already exposes them
the same mechanism hand-written once per axis or per device
candidate_classes.remediation: delete the hand-written state machine, pass the real site conditions into the official FB arguments, and take status from its Done/Busy/Error outputs

candidate_classes.name: portable_logic_should_become_user_fb
candidate_classes.applies_only_when: no official FB covers the capability
candidate_classes.evidence_requirement: house standard plus reuse evidence (same logic repeated per axis or station, or needing migration to another machine); no KEYENCE document required
detection: identical logic repeated in two or more programs with only variable/constant differences
the logic depends only on its own arguments and local state (no global soft-device access)
candidate_classes.remediation: extract to 功能块/FB_*, one instance per axis/station, and let the site programs keep device mapping and sequencing

reuse_principle.instance_rule: every official FB (MC_Power/MC_Home/MC_Stop/...) also needs its own instance per axis, and a user FB (only when class B applies) is likewise one instance per axis or station; sharing a single instance across axes (for example one MC_Power instance driving three axes, or MC_Home2 used for axes 2 and 3) is a defect, not a style question, consistent with the vendor rule that each axis needs its own MC_Power
anti_patterns: wrapping an official FB in a user FB to give it a name (adds a private interface, adds no capability)
moving duplicated hand-written ladder into a user FB and calling that an optimisation (the duplication survives, only the file changes)
renaming or relocating a scan program that contains hand-written state machines (the name changes, the defect does not)
deleting, inverting or bypassing a condition whose meaning nobody can explain, just to make the structure look clean
reuse_principle.unknown_signal_rule: If the meaning of a condition cannot be established (no comment, no owner answer), keep it as an input member of the official FB call and list it in the delivery report as meaning-to-be-confirmed. Never bypass it for structural tidiness.
delivery_requirements: count of hand-written lines deleted, per module, and which official FB now owns that capability
the site conditions that were kept, with device, current comment and where they now appear
a behaviour-difference list (before -> after) that the owner must review before downloading
items that could not be replaced, with the evidence for why
reuse_principle.example: Taizhou machine (2026-11): the program already called MC_Home/MC_Jog/MC_Reset/MC_Stop yet also hand-built their rising edges, holds, direction interlocks and busy/done flags in ladder (~190 of 214 lines). The correct fix is to delete that ladder and feed the site conditions into the official FB arguments; moving it into a user FB, or wrapping the official FBs in one, is the anti-pattern.

advisory_checks.meaning: 模块名看起来是 FB，但类别是程序（;MODULE_TYPE:0）
advisory_checks.suggest: 把可复用逻辑移到 功能块/FB_*，调用方放在 程序/.../调用*FB；按房规，可复用或需移植的标准程序都必须做成 FB（见 reuse_principle）

advisory_checks.meaning: 没有任何 ST##_* 工站程序
advisory_checks.suggest: 按工序拆分，或确认本项目确实无工位概念

advisory_checks.meaning: 缺少 初始化/设备状态/Alarm/HMI/IO 等平台功能分区
advisory_checks.suggest: 按需补齐，或在总结里说明由上位机/HMI 承担

advisory_checks.meaning: 自定义类型没有按 str<域>+Ctrl/Param/Status 分层
advisory_checks.suggest: 整理类型，便于复用与跨项目迁移

advisory_checks.meaning: 被引用但没有注释的软元件（见 text/comments/coverage.json 的 used_unannotated）
advisory_checks.suggest: 至少给判定、参数、状态区补注释

advisory_checks.meaning: 同一个 FB 实例在一个扫描周期被调用多次（或跨轴复用同一实例）
advisory_checks.suggest: 每个轴/工位一个独立实例

flow: summarize_kv_project（非 UI，产出项目总结：功能/工站/接口/数据地图/缺口）
extract_kv_project_structure + assert_kv_project_standard（非 UI，产出标准报告）
向用户展示总结与不合规项，询问是否按范例调整（必须询问，不擅自改）
用户同意后：生成迁移计划 → 在工程副本上执行 → 编译验证
